## Work Experience

### Capgemini Technology Services India Limited — Gurugram, India (Aug 2020 – Present)

Progression: Consultant → Senior Consultant → Manager → Senior Manager (3 promotions in 6 years).

#### Senior Manager | Chief of Staff & AI Transformation Lead — Cloud & Custom Applications India (C&CA) (Nov 2023 – Present)

Strategic advisor to the unit CEO and partner to the unit COO for a ~20,000-person practice; 7 direct and ~50 indirect reports.

- **Enterprise AI enablement at scale:** Built Capgemini India's first AI upskilling architecture for senior executives across 13 technology hubs. As Chief AI Trainer, ran a train-the-trainer model that certified 300+ trainers, who in turn upskilled 2,000+ senior executives across Capgemini offices — producing thousands of working prototypes, each scoped against a named enterprise use case rather than a demo, and now a reusable asset for Capgemini.
- **Chief AI Trainer & National Enablement Lead:** Formulated Capgemini's train-the-trainer (TTT) operating model; personally upskilled 300+ certified trainers and guided 1,000+ executives toward a tool-agnostic AI mindset, using Claude and agentic frameworks to move teams from basic prompt engineering to hands-on vibe coding and production AI execution.
- **Candidate evaluation transformation — ~$1.9M annual savings:** Replaced manual bench validation with an adaptive assessment engine and AI-led voice interviews across 5,000+ associates. Average bench tenure fell from 117 to under 60 days — removing ~57 days of idle cost per associate across a ~2,000-person fresher pool — and external certification failure dropped from 20% to under 5%.
- **Program execution control tower:** Partnered with the unit COO to convert the India PMO from a reporting function into a control tower — governing 9 transformation programmes across 38+ business leaders under one KPI architecture that feeds the quarterly executive review.
- **Account opportunity engine:** Built an account opportunity-mining model across the top 50 accounts, now used by the Centre of Excellence to target high-propensity accounts and prioritise margin-accretive AI use cases.
- **B-School talent, early-career redesign:** Rebuilt the Chrysalis management-trainee lifecycle with automated talent-to-demand matching and a structured two-year career roadmap — doubling billability from 30% to 60%, cutting intake cycle time by 80%, and reducing first-year trainee attrition by ~90%.
- **Reporting & process automation:** Established practice-wide reporting on the unit data lake — Power BI dashboards, the unit budget model, and the multi-layer leadership structure for the new unit — while advising the unit CEO. Digitised day-to-day operations on SharePoint and deployed Microsoft 365 and Power BI Copilot.
- **Executive strategy workshops:** Designed and repeatedly facilitated multi-day sessions for 15+ VP and EVP stakeholders on budget, hiring, KPI trees, and organisation design.
- **Community leadership & knowledge management:** Created a single governance charter across five professional communities — Industry, Architect, AI, Business Analyst, and Engagement Manager (~15,000 professionals) — plus the central knowledge portal and Power BI dashboards; drove the highest industry-certification volume across Capgemini India.
- **Marketing playbook & multi-level org chart:** For C&CA India (unit formed January 2024), created the marketing playbook and organisation chart used with internal stakeholders and clients.

Client demonstrations lifted stakeholder engagement by 15%; upsell work contributed a 5% revenue increase.

- **Pre-sales & innovation:** Led a five-person team to an AWS-funded machine-learning extension of DEX at the 2022 Media & Entertainment internal hackathon; contributed to the RFP response and proposal defence on a won bid.

#### Consultant | Scrum Master & Community Marketing Lead (Aug 2020 – Sep 2021)

- **Scrum Master, Industrial IoT plant control tower (Baker Hughes):** Ran agile delivery for a cloud-agnostic AWS and Azure migration, achieving 95% on-time sprint delivery and a 20% improvement in delivery timelines.
- **Marketing Team Lead, North America Architect Community:** Led a six-person marketing team and secured INR 1.55L in contest funding; the programme produced 18 blogs and 9 points of view in 3.5 months and drew 1,200+ architects. Won the Capgemini Super Team Award 2021.
